# laravel_cloud_regions (Data Source)

Lists available Laravel Cloud regions.

~> **Beta:** This provider is in beta. Its resources and attributes may change between releases, so pin the provider version and read the changelog before you upgrade.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_regions" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `regions` (Attributes List) Available cloud regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `flag` (String) Country identifier for the region's flag, such as `us` or `germany`. Not an emoji.
- `label` (String) Human-readable region label.
- `name` (String) Region identifier (such as us-east-1).
